name: social-account-doctor
description_zh: 小红书/抖音/快手/视频号自媒体「找对标→拆爆款→套自己」四命令闭环。给出账号/选题方向/原始素材，输出可发的下一条笔记初稿（标题+封面大字+首段+CTA）。支持 compose（素材打底）、find（找对标）、crack（拆爆款）、adapt（仿写）四个核心命令。
description_en: Social media content creation pipeline for Xiaohongshu/Douyin/Kuaishou/WeChat Channels. Four-command closed loop: compose (material analysis) → find (benchmark discovery) → crack (viral content breakdown) → adapt (personalized adaptation). Outputs ready-to-publish drafts with titles, cover text, opening paragraph, and CTA.
